description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for the EmployeeCSVImportAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It tests various API endpoints related to employee CSV import functionality, including validation rules, create, delete, and get methods, though many are expected to throw NotImplemented exceptions. It uses mock services and APIs to verify behavior.

classes.name: EmployeeCSVImportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class that verifies the behavior of EmployeeCSVImportAPI, particularly its validation logic and multiple API endpoints, using mocks and expected exceptions.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getAll method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForGetAll method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Validates the rules returned by getValidationRuleForCreate, ensuring the CSV attachment data structure and size are validated.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create method, mocking the import service and checking the returned meta information for success, failure, and failed rows.
